title: Photoactivated Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry for Probing Multidomain Protein Dynamics in Inducible Nitric Oxide Synthase.
authors: Jiang, Ting; Zhang, Haikun; Gyawali, Yadav Prasad; Owopetu, Rebecca; Lee, Kanghyun; Feng, Changjian
one_liner_zh: 该文利用光活化交联质谱（XL-MS）探测诱导型一氧化氮合酶多结构域蛋白的构象动态，虽涉及蛋白构象计算建模（交联距离约束），但方法为实验质谱而非AI或物理模拟，且未提出可迁移的结构计算算法，故评分为6。
abstract: Cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) with photoactivatable reagents has been increasingly applied to probe protein conformational dynamics; however, its sensitivity to shifts in conformational equilibrium involving transient, sparsely populated docked states within multidomain proteins remains largely unexplored. Mammalian nitric oxide synthase (NOS), a family of modular redox enzymes, relies on large-amplitude FMN domain swinging motions and local, dynamic interdomain FMN-heme docking to function. This makes it a stringent test case for evaluating how sensitive photoactivated XL-MS is to shifts in the docking equilbrium. In our previous work, quantitative XL-MS using the primarily lysine-reactive homobifunctional cross-linker DSBU revealed E546N mutation-induced decreases in specific intersubunit FMN-heme cross-links in an oxygenase/FMN construct of human inducible NOS (iNOS). Here, we extended these XL-MS studies to sulfo-SDA, a heterobifunctional, photoactivatable cross-linker with ultrafast reactivity and broad residue specificity. SDA captured interdomain FMN-heme cross-links at the docking interfaces but, unlike DSBU, did not reveal statistically robust changes in the abundances of these cross-links between wild-type and E546N mutant. SDA produced a higher proportion of dead-end labeling products for iNOS oxyFMN proteins, particularly the E546N mutant, than for the conformationally stable protein BSA. Moreover, the SDA cross-link distance restraints were largely satisfied by a minimal subset of docked states with distinct FMN domain orientations, whereas DSBU cross-links require a combination of docked and undocked conformations for optimal restraint satisfaction. These findings reflect the short effective distance range and near-instantaneous reactivity of SDA, which restrict FMN-heme cross-link formation to a narrow subset of transient docking states. Taken together, these results underscore the importance of selecting appropriate cross-linking reagents and employing complementary cross-linkers to define the conformational landscapes of dynamic multidomain proteins.
abstract_zh: 交联质谱（XL-MS）结合光活化试剂已越来越多地用于探测蛋白质构象动态；然而，其对涉及多结构域蛋白内瞬时、低丰度对接状态的构象平衡移动的敏感性在很大程度上仍未得到探索。哺乳动物一氧化氮合酶（NOS）是一类模块化氧化还原酶家族，其功能依赖于大幅度的FMN结构域摆动运动以及局部、动态的结构域间FMN-血红素对接。这使其成为评估光活化XL-MS对对接平衡移动敏感性的严格测试案例。在我们先前的工作中，使用主要针对赖氨酸反应的同双功能交联剂DSBU进行的定量XL-MS揭示了人诱导型NOS（iNOS）的加氧酶/FMN构建体中E546N突变诱导的特定亚基间FMN-血红素交联减少。在此，我们将这些XL-MS研究扩展到sulfo-SDA，一种具有超快反应性和广泛残基特异性的异双功能光活化交联剂。SDA在对接界面捕获了结构域间FMN-血红素交联，但与DSBU不同，它未显示野生型和E546N突变体之间这些交联丰度的统计学显著变化。SDA对iNOS oxyFMN蛋白（尤其是E546N突变体）产生的死端标记产物比例高于构象稳定的蛋白BSA。此外，SDA交联距离约束主要由具有不同FMN结构域方向的最小对接状态子集满足，而DSBU交联则需要对接和未对接构象的组合以实现最佳约束满足。这些发现反映了SDA的短有效距离范围和近乎瞬时的反应性，这限制了FMN-血红素交联形成于狭窄的瞬时对接状态子集。综合来看，这些结果强调了选择合适交联试剂并采用互补交联剂以定义动态多结构域蛋白构象景观的重要性。
